decisions.reason: The source changes when a prospect is entered into HubSpot, not which interested prospects belong in the separate tracking spreadsheet.
Changing the condition for adding secured prospects to HubSpot does not alter the required contact properties or resolve the existing property-permission blockage.
The HubSpot entry condition does not change the delivery or wording requirements for Airbnb host outreach messages.
The source decision concerns secured prospect entry into HubSpot and does not affect daily social scheduling or publishing.
The HubSpot prospect-entry threshold is unrelated to CJ Dropshipping product-selection criteria.
The source decision does not change the content-bank artifact, storage platform, or scope.
The source decision has no semantic effect on Pinterest competitor research or its required links.
